title: Set up the DMARC report mailbox and publish DMARC for the sending domains
description:
**What.** Publish DMARC for every sending domain (anth.us and mail.machines-on-machines.anth.us today) and have a place that receives the aggregate (rua) reports, so we can see who is sending as us and whether SPF and DKIM align. No DMARC record exists for either domain today (finding of 2026-11-12, see PPY-a85725).

**What is needed.**
- A mailbox, or an aggregate-report service, that receives the `rua` reports and that someone reads. Owner: Ryan decides which (no mailbox exists yet, Ryan 2026-11-12). The address is configuration in AWS, never written into the repository (placeholders in specs).
- The `_dmarc` TXT record for each sending domain published through the DNS template in Git and applied by the pipeline. Never a hand-made record.
- Start at `p=none` with `rua` pointing at that mailbox; read the reports; tighten to `quarantine` (then `reject`) only when reports show SPF and DKIM aligned for every legitimate sender. The move to a stricter policy is its own reviewed change.
- If the mailbox is on a different domain than the one being reported on, the external-destination authorization record DMARC requires is part of the same template.

**Done when.** Each sending domain resolves a DMARC record from the template, a first aggregate report has arrived and been read, and the readiness check in PPY-a85725 passes its DMARC item.

**Why this is priority 1.** The Machines on Machines launch (PPY-f4b164) is blocked by this task, so signup cannot open without it.

**Owner decision needed (Ryan):** which mailbox or report service receives the DMARC reports.

comments.text: Part 1 merged to develop in #1692 (not released): infra/email/papyrus-dmarc.yaml publishes _dmarc.<domain> at p=none with rua taken from an SSM parameter (stack holds only the NAME /papyrus/dmarc/report-address; no address anywhere in Git, specs use a placeholder), no external-destination record needed (same organisational domain), pipeline roles gain papyrus-dmarc-*; spec features_backend/dmarc-report-record.feature. Part 2 is draft PR #1694 (the two stacks for anth.us and mail.machines-on-machines.anth.us in stacks.json); its dry run fails until the roles apply. Nothing deployed. Deploy steps remaining, in order: (1) a person approves the role-stack-deploy run for the roles change; (2) a person creates the String parameter /papyrus/dmarc/report-address in papyrus-production with the existing anth.us mailbox's address; (3) re-run checks on #1694 and merge, then the release deploys both stacks; (4) a first aggregate report arrives and is read, then a stricter policy is its own change. Not covered: notify.anth.us keeps its own _dmarc record (no rua) from the operators newsletter stack, a separate follow-up. Owner decision (which mailbox) now given by the parent task: an existing anth.us mailbox.
